interface_change.new_method: AppendCTZeroSample(ref SeriesRef, l labels.Labels, t, ct int64) (SeriesRef, error)
interface_change.description: Adds support for appending synthetic zero samples at the created timestamp (CT). Similar to AppendSTZeroSample for start timestamps, this method allows callers to inject a zero-value sample at the metric's created timestamp, which is used for accurate rate calculations over counter resets. The CT (created timestamp) indicates when a counter was created/reset, and the zero sample ensures correct rate computation from the beginning of the counter's lifecycle.

answer.implementation_pattern: Follow the same pattern as AppendSTZeroSample: validate that ct < t (created timestamp must be older than sample timestamp), append a float64 zero sample at timestamp ct for the given series, and return the series reference. Implementations that don't support created timestamps should return an appropriate error or no-op.
